results.title: Esperança
results.overview: A 12-year-old Black girl dreams of becoming a professional soccer player in the outskirts of Brazil, facing exclusion on the field and resistance at home.

results.title: Bardaasht
results.overview: After being falsely imprisoned, Karma returns to his village determined to take revenge on the man who destroyed his family.

results.title: The Brightest Sun
results.overview: When a private detective is murdered, a former colleague and a trainee detective are sent to investigate. Along the way, they uncover a tragic truth that triggers memories from their own haunted pasts.

results.title: Das Theater im Sucher - Die Fotografin Ruth Walz
results.original_title: Das Theater im Sucher - Die Fotografin Ruth Walz
results.overview: For half a century, photographer Ruth Walz has been immersing herself in Europe’s theaters and opera houses, capturing the action on stage with passion and an unerring eye. Her theater photographs have set the standard for decades. In conversation with her colleagues, the unique stature and role of her photography are confirmed.

results.title: The Quiet Beekeeper
results.overview: In the small community of Åmotfors in Värmland, Olof lives a quiet life as a beekeeper after losing his partner many years ago. All that remains is his teenage daughter Lise, who increasingly seeks to escape the confines of home. Olof struggles to reach her, and grief has long lain buried in silence—until he suddenly falls ill and is forced to confront all that has remained unspoken. With great sensitivity, Marcus Carlsson portrays the different stages of life and reminds us how the fragility between people can hold both pain and light.

results.title: Origin Story
results.overview: Sofia (Valentina Herszage), a 20-year-old Brazilian actress, arrives at a casting audition for an American film that quickly departs from the familiar.  ORIGIN STORY explores identity, performance, and the enduring influence of the American gaze upon Latin American culture.

results.title: Sola
results.overview: A young woman who suffers from chronic sleep paralysis awakens to find the world around her has descended into a zombie apocalypse.

results.title: MagNata
results.overview: It is a cold night and there is an electric tension in the air. A box is passed from hand to hand by mafia figures with professional secrecy. They have all been ordered to pass it on to the next courier without opening it, but one of the members is following different orders.

results.title: Crooked Miles
results.overview: Desperate people receive a mystical gift that grants wishes, collects souls, and creates monsters.

results.title: Jeffrey Epstein: The Bad Sleep Well
results.original_title: Jeffrey Epstein: The Bad Sleep Well
results.overview: Over the course of one troubled week, Jeffrey Epstein struggles with guilt, ambition, and growing pressure as his world of wealth and influence begins to close in on him.

results.title: Waru
results.overview: Adrian's career as a businessman who tries his hand at politics is going well, but the situation at home is inversely proportional. His wife was locked up in the basement because of a mental disorder. His son is in a coma after being involved in a mysterious tragedy which resulted in the loss of other people's lives. As if that wasn't terrible enough, his family begins to be terrorized by a female ghost. The tragedy brings Adrian to flashbacks of the past. Long before achieving success, his life had suffered greatly. When almost giving up, a help appears. Connecting it to a sacred hibiscus tree which apparently did not give all success to Adrian for nothing. Is the destruction of his family a fair price for what Adrian has achieved? Or is there another secret that hasn't been uncovered from his past?

results.title: Aashaan
results.overview: Aashaan dreams of cinema until a 150-member film crew enters his life, bringing movie magic within reach. Chasing his big break, he confronts the industry's harsh realities.

results.title: Learning, Studying… Always Perfecting: The Making of One Battle After Another
results.original_title: Learning, Studying… Always Perfecting: The Making of One Battle After Another
results.overview: A behind-the-scenes documentary filmed during the production of Paul Thomas Anderson’s One Battle After Another, featuring candid moments from the cast and crew.

results.title: The Con Artist
results.overview: Fanny, 30 years old and pregnant, is exhausted from living with her father alongside Virgil, her partner who’s a master of procrastination. When she stumbles upon a rent-to-own listing for a charming Parisian apartment with vintage appeal, she begins to believe she’s found her chance to finally turn her life around. But the saleswoman, Masséna, is far from fitting the image of a fragile, dying property owner. Determined to seize what she sees as her chance at independence, Fanny launches into a ruthless war against the woman she perceives as a calculating con artist.

results.title: Dante
results.overview: 10 million euros go missing and the prime suspect is forced to flee and ends up in the city dump. In the search for the truth, two heads clash – but what price friendship?

results.title: Phoolan
results.overview: Follows an impoverished 17-year-old girl who becomes a famous outlaw and survives a brutal 48-hour siege when thousands of armed men trap her in a village.

results.title: The Woman with Three Husbands
results.overview: Concerned her impressionable brother has joined an isolated polyamorous family, Natalie investigates her new 'in-laws'. The strange death of one of Marcus's fellow 'brother husbands' leads Natalie to realize her brother is living with a killer

results.title: The Passion According to G.H.B.
results.overview: As rain falls in São Paulo, in an unassuming apartment building a random Grindr hookup is multiplying into a frenzied orgy. Over the course of a day and into the night, Matias and his new lovers connect over fucking, a cornucopia of drugs, and classic literature. Matias confides in his companions about his life — his HIV status, his old lovers, his relationship with drugs — while he ponders what the future holds in a fast-changing, post-pandemic world. In his heightened state, Matias is visited by the apparition of G.H., the titular figure from Clarice Lispector‘s landmark novel The Passion According to G.H.

results.title: Windows on the World: 9/11's Forgotten Story
results.original_title: Windows on the World: 9/11's Forgotten Story
results.overview: Twenty-five years after 9/11, this gripping documentary tells the untold story of the 170 people trapped inside Windows on the World, the iconic restaurant on the top floors of the World Trade Center’s North Tower.
